_comment: "put a face-up card from your arsenal on the bottom of your deck. IF YOU DO, draw a card and this gets +1{d}." The 'if you do' was not modelled: with an empty arsenal the card drew and buffed anyway, which is the payoff without the cost. Gating on "is your arsenal non-empty" is not the same question either -- with a FACE-DOWN card in arsenal the arsenal is non-empty and nothing is bottomed -- so PUT_ARSENAL_BOTTOM records what it moved and the gate is REF_EXISTS over that. The +1{d} also went to the defending TOTAL rather than to THIS card. And PUT_ARSENAL_BOTTOM defaults to OPPONENT -- the three Disable printings were its first users -- so with no 'player' key this card bottomed the OPPONENT's arsenal card, which is why its own 'if you do' could never be satisfied. 'A FACE-UP card' is a real restriction too: arsenal cards are face down by default. Removed a fabricated STATIC_TRIGGERED ON_DEFEND -> INTIMIDATE ability earlier: the card has no intimidate text; the generator hallucinated it from Blade Break equipment (27 cards corpus-wide).
